concept: A large crowd of silhouetted figures standing shoulder-to-shoulder in a tightly packed formation, viewed from above, their heads rendered as simple geometric shapes in dark tones. The composition fills the frame edge-to-edge with bodies, creating a dense, almost abstract pattern of human shapes. The lighting is harsh and overhead, casting sharp shadows. The mood is tense and claustrophobic, neither celebratory nor violent but heavy with pressure and constraint. Style: high-contrast, graphic, resembling a political woodcut or protest poster.
explanation: Today's headlines are dominated by cycles of violence, containment, and social upheaval across multiple continents—riots and police deployments in France, deadly attacks in Jordan and Paris, military demolitions in Palestine, election tensions in Serbia and Alaska, disease outbreaks, and torture revelations. Rather than depicting any single tragedy, I chose to visualize the underlying current: the compression of populations under surveillance, restriction, and mutual suspicion. The overhead view suggests both surveillance and powerlessness, while the packed silhouettes capture the tension between collective human presence and systems designed to control or fragment it.

headlines.title: France prepares for day of protest a week after nationwide riots
headlines.summary: More than 70,000 police officers are to be deployed over fears protesters will defy restrictions on demonstrations.

headlines.title: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya
headlines.summary: She was a close family member of the first victim, a man who had travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo.

headlines.title: Arrest made after fire at Hitler's Eagle's Nest retreat
headlines.summary: Around 200 emergency personnel are deployed to fight the blaze at the Nazi dictator's Alpine residence in Germany.

headlines.title: Student movement takes Serbia's Vučić to the wire in neck-and-neck election
headlines.summary: The Student List has emerged from almost two years of anti-corruption protests to form the biggest challenge to Vučić's rule.

headlines.title: Trump administration sues to block certification of upcoming Alaska election
headlines.summary: The justice department has filed a lawsuit arguing that the inclusion of two candidates named Dan Sullivan could confuse voters.

headlines.title: Seven shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say
headlines.summary: Thirty-four people are also injured in the attack in southern Karak governorate, and a manhunt is now under way.

headlines.title: Australian MP's condition improves after alleged car attack
headlines.summary: The Independent MP is now in a serious but stable condition, according to the Melbourne hospital.

headlines.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
headlines.summary: The soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint outside the West Bank city on Friday morning.

headlines.title: Argentina drops investigation into President Milei over crypto fraud
headlines.summary: Javier Milei had denied acting fraudulently when a cryptocurrency nosedived after he deleted a social media post about it.

headlines.title: White House says Melania Trump brokered truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
headlines.summary: Ukraine and Russia confirm the truce in Russian-occupied Oleshky, where residents have had to eat garden weeds to survive.

headlines.title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
headlines.summary: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks. The suspected gunman has been apprehended.

headlines.title: Freed US citizen was tortured in Russian jail, former Ukrainian prisoners say
headlines.summary: Ukrainians held alongside the American say they witnessed beatings and sexual humiliation by Russian guards during his detention.
